title: Argument-parser failures bypass JSON error envelopes
findings_note: S46 planning; slicer edit --json prints argparse usage only

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `slicer edit --json` with missing required arguments exits 2 with argparse usage on stderr and no JSON on stdout. cli.main calls parse_args before its SlicerError handler. Agents cannot use the documented error envelope for parser failures.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Missing required arguments, unknown options, invalid choices and conflicting parser options produce a usage envelope when --json is requested. Human errors and --help still work.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Bring parser errors into the machine-readable usage contract, including nested commands. Preserve normal help and human-readable errors.

**Not in this slice:** changing command semantics or accepting invalid arguments.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Exercise real command invocations and assert exit status, stdout JSON, and stderr diagnostics.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Follow owner instructions; no automatic commit.
